newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian air force F-16 jet crashes.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian air force F-16 jet crashes.

text.p: An Indonesian air force F-16 jet crashed at the Halim Perdanakusuma air base in east Jakarta on Monday, but there were no immediate reports of casualties, an air force official said.
"The plane crashed at 1.30 p.m. (0630 GMT) in Halim," said the official. He declined to give further details.
Air force spokesmen were not available for comment.
Indonesia's air force currently has more than 80 combat aircraft, including 12 F-16s made by Lockheed Martin Corp of the United States.
